notes: Hanifield is printed 'HANIFIELD ST.' on the plate. Westfork Road runs along the top plate edge; only its south side is drawn, so the y of the Colerain crossing is a guess at the edge (x from Colerain's centre). Kirby Avenue (north of Hoffner, 60 ft) continues south of Hoffner as Runnymeade Avenue (50 ft), centres about 10 px apart; one crossing recorded. Herron Avenue is 50 ft north of Hoffner (centre x 1067) and 60 ft south (centre x 1082); pick is the mean. Hoffner Avenue is drawn only about 75 px wide (printed 25') west of x 2240; centre taken between the block fronts. Powers Street runs along the bottom plate edge: north side at y 7143, a line at y 7200, printed 50'; the centre y 7210 assumes a 50 ft street measured from the north side, so y may be 20-40 px off. A solid line runs down the middle of Kirby (x about 1800-1822) and Herron (x about 1087-1108): a boundary, not a street edge. No named alleys in the strip. | Runnymeade Avenue: the name RUNNYMEADE is printed south of Hoffner (50 ft) and the word AVENUE on the same line north of Wolcott (60 ft); read as one street from Powers to Colerain, with a small jog at Hoffner (centre x about 1839 north, 1828 south). The line near x 1805 in it is a water pipe. Hanifield Street is printed both on the north-south street meeting Colerain at x 1568 and along the top edge east of Jerome; its west edge and the bend between the two legs are off the plate, so the Colerain T centre assumes the 60 ft width from the east edge. Hanifield/Jerome: top street cut by the plate edge, centre y uncertain (+-30). Powers Street is cut by the bottom neat line (about y 7200); north edge y 7140-7145, centre taken near the neat line, uncertain +-30 in y. Hoffner Avenue is drawn only about 70 px wide (printed 25). West Fork Road (top left) meets Colerain off the top edge: not picked. Unnamed 12 ft alley between Cass and Herron (x about 720-735, Hoffner to Powers): not picked.
